info.name: Get a list of all Groups

params.name: page_size
params.description: The max size of each page of results

params.name: offset
params.description: The integer offset at which to start the page. Possible values are 0 to total_records - 1

params.name: company
params.description: This query param searches groups by name or dba_name values

params.name: group_ids
params.description: Comma-separated list of requested UUID group IDs

params.name: carrier_id
params.description: Used for filtering for a carrier-specific group ID. Filter by the Noyo carrier ID. Must be used with carrier_group_id

params.name: carrier_group_id
params.description: Used for filtering for a carrier-specific group ID. Must be used with carrier_id

items.docs:
Returns a list of all groups in the current user organization.

If you would like to search the groups list, you can use the company query param. It allows searches based on the group's name or dba_name values.
Create a new group.
